theorems.name: Submission.cmrc_measure_le_of_compactlyContained
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (m : ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen U → IsOpen W → μ Uᶜ = 0 → (∀ W' : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W' → CompactlyContained W' U → W' ⊆ W → μ W' ≤ m) → μ W ≤ m
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
